text_block_list.text:
Immediately after the practice match concluded,
two Umamusume were on their way back with puzzled expressions.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "Last time, I thought you were no match for me... but you completely outplayed me."

A team that has grown to the point of being
just one step away from defeating Team <First>.
While she rejoiced, Chairwoman Akikawa's stance on Acting Director Kashimoto upon returning to Japan was to 'wait and see.'

Nothing changed at the academy,
and several days passed in bewilderment—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. What on earth could the Chairwoman be thinking?
What is going to happen to the Academy?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "It is all right! Because—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: If we win the Aoharu Cup, case closed! Right?

With that renewed mindset,
we continued our training. Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fuku-chan, you're just a little bit away from a new record!
Keep it up--!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hngnnnnn~!!
Go-Good-fortune DAAAAAASH!

While she worked hard at her training,
a figure was watching her in secret.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Being with them makes me feel motivated
to give it my all—that's the kind of team this is...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...'To receive someone's feelings,' huh...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Fancy seeing you here, Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Same as you, just scouting.
I'd hate to just sit back and let them walk all over us.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Still, watching them for a bit got me thinking...
All those cheers and encouragement, it's the exact opposite of our place."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
If anything, there's a lot our team eliminated...
To be honest, it's hard to make a judgment.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: What are your thoughts on this?
At Bitter Glace's question, Little Cocon lowered her gaze in hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer Kashimoto's program isn't bad.
In fact, my results have improved.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, those guys are just running on wishy-washy, buddy-buddy resolve, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Her late surge completely outmatched ours.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"So right now, I'm thinking about what they've got
that we don't, but—"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: You're saying you can't find the answer?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I haven't found it, more like...
I just don't wanna admit it...
...And with that, she raised her head, furrowing her brow.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-oh, they're coming this way.
Let's find somewhere else, Bitter Glasse.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I see! In other words, we were subconsciously setting limits on ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Roughly speaking, yeah.

Little Cocon let out a small sigh
before speaking.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: "We believe in Trainer Kashimoto's precise program."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I believed in it, I grew complacent without realizing it.
Thinking I'd get stronger just by following the program."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: On the other hand... because they tasted defeat once, they pushed past their limits. They fought their hardest for the sake of their teammates.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hmm... For the sake of your friends, huh?
After pondering for a moment, Bitter Glace looked at Little Cocon as if testing her.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Well then, how about we join forces and do some training together, just like those girls?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Like hell I would. Not a chance. It's not like I think of teammates as my friends or anything.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That startled me. But in that case,
what are you going to do? What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not just me. None of us really get
the whole 'running for your friends' thing. But—"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Trainer Kashimoto's sake...
I'm sure I can reach beyond my limits.

"The day after that quiet conversation—
Team <First> sneaked over
and gathered by the hollow of the giant tree."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"You heard what we said, right?
So everyone's on board, yeah?"

Confirming her teammates were nodding with grave expressions,
Little Cocon took out a notebook.
Inside, completed workouts, dates, and their effects were jotted down in meticulous detail.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...To decide on the details of our upcoming additional training,
I analyzed Trainer Kashimoto's program.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
This is actually pretty detailed.
The workload fluctuates precisely based on condition and stats, you see.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, but still... Trainer Kashimoto
calculated and planned this with incredible precision.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
The more I understand, the more amazed I am by
how well they understand us and manage everything...!
At Bitter Glace's words, the surrounding teammates nodded deeply in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Still... we have to take Trainer Kashimoto's
100% understanding and surpass it at 120%.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: "We failed because we stayed confined within the ruler we were given."

—And from the very next day,
Team First began their secret extra training.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
*pant, pant*..."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "...Whew, right after training is always tough! My legs feel like lead, and I'm getting kind of sleepy..."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Don't whine now.
...You can do one more, no, two more reps, right?!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...! Of course!
